column1: # Provisional game profile of Moving Out 2 (Switch, update 1.3.315 = v327680 over the base game)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# Written from a survey of the game files (scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py with dm/games/profile_guess.py); packed on a PC, not run on a device. The keys below are
# the survey's guesses, not measured. README.md beside this file.
# Unity 2021.3.16f1 (IL2CPP) with FMOD, SDK 14.3.1, NVN. Blasphemous 2 (Unity 2021.3.20f1, SDK 15.3.2) and Chained Echoes (SDK 14.3.0) are the closest profiles.
# 1.3.315: the update's NSP name; the dump folder has no control data (the survey's display version is "?")
# every module main imports from; subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie
# guess, not measured: the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap; the 5 GB block and hardware pool are the survey's
# rule (Blasphemous 2, Unity 2021.3.20f1, SDK 15.3.2; Chained Echoes, SDK 14.3.0). The first run's SetHeapSize lines decide the heap region and mem_used.
# Measured on the Lenovo TB321FU (2026-11-19): StandardAllocator's region is 3.14 GB and the game's other address regions (Unity's GPU memory, a 16 MB region per
# render target) filled the 4.375 GB alias region to +4.03 GB of regions with 351 MB of gaps by the tutorial; there the render targets the level makes could not get their
# regions, Unity left their textures uninitialized and drew every other frame without its colour target (the full-screen flicker, README.md). The block is 6 GB, as Art of
# Rally's, giving the alias region 1 GB more
# The game sets present interval 2 (30 fps) in play; Unity times its logic in seconds, so presenting every display tick runs it at 60 fps at normal speed,
# as The Hong Kong Massacre's profile does (Lenovo TB321FU, Turnip, 2026-11-19)
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; Unity Shader and ComputeShader objects, read by unityfs.py) ----
